ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Common, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (PommelStrike.cs:22-25) == cost 1 / ATTACK / COMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalTags.rationale: `new HashSet<CardTag> { CardTag.Strike }` (PommelStrike.cs:14) == the tag set, which card/perfected_strike counts and the Sharpened enchantment keys on.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(9m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new CardsVar(1)` (PommelStrike.cs:16-20) == both numbers, both declared.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: attack FIRST (PommelStrike.cs:30-32), then `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner)` (33) == `DrawCmd.draw(ctx.player, self._cards)`. The draw is unconditional on both sides.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Damage.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` + `DynamicVars.Cards.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (PommelStrike.cs:38-39) == `_damage += 1` (9 -> 10) and `_cards += 1` (1 -> 2). Both upgraded numbers checked -- and the +1 damage is unusually small, so transcribing it as the more common +3 would be easy.
